title: What the Star-nosed Mole means

is_this_you.pressure: You go under. You work the problem by feel, in the dark, then surface with one sentence nobody can argue with.
is_this_you.love: You remember the story they told once, two years ago, and you bring it up on the day they need it.
is_this_you.cost: You keep a careful file on the friend you forgave, and you add to it in silence.

opener.text: In the first chapter of the Zhuangzi, a hermit turns down a throne with one line: 偃鼠飲河，不過滿腹 (yǎn shǔ yǐn hé, bùguò mǎn fù). The mole drinks from the river and takes only a bellyful [S18]. Most translators give the animal as a mole [S18]. You were born knowing that measure. Enough is a real amount to you.

howto: Three parts. Feel your way in.

rows.text: Virgo is mutable Earth, ruled by Mercury [S8]. It checks everything and finds it hard to switch off [S8] [S10]. The Pig is yin Water, kind and calm under pressure [S11] [S12]. In you the sorter meets the feeler. You take in a lot and say little. Then you move fast.

The mole shifts its star so the two small rays by its mouth touch each thing first [S2]. Under water it blows bubbles and breathes them back in, eight to twelve a second, to smell [S1] [S5]. The biologist Kenneth Catania says the moles use the star the way we use our eyes [S7]. You read people like that, by the grain of a voice and by what shifted since last week.

The Pig enjoys the good life [S11]. Virgo's old correspondences are the harvest and the granary [S9]. So you enjoy the meal and count the grain. Warm bread. A soft bed. Then you stop. Others keep reaching. You leave the river.
In winter the mole's tail swells with stored fat [S1] [S6]. It carries its reserve close and small. Yours sits the same way, where nobody has to see it.
The Pig's known weak spot is trusting too easily [S11]. You can miss a motive while you study the details. Check the reason as closely as you check the facts.

tabs.label: Who you let close
tabs.intro: A small, warm burrow with space for two.
tabs.love_lead: You love through attention, and it shows in the small things. When you are hurt, you withdraw and say nothing for a while. The old wheel gives you three easy burrows to share.

easy.why: The Koala (Taurus, Rabbit year) shares the Pig's trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and Taurus is Earth like you [S14] [S10].
The Hercules Beetle (Capricorn, Goat year) closes your trine, and Capricorn is the third Earth sign [S14] [S10].
The Moon Bear (Cancer, Tiger year) is your secret friend, since the Tiger is the Pig's Liu He partner, and Cancer's Water suits your Earth [S14] [S10].

hard.why: The hard one is the Glass Frog, because Snake clashes with Pig and Pisces sits opposite Virgo [S14] [S8].

story.text: Zuni carvers make stone mole fetishes for protection, credited with healing and hunting power, as the University of New Mexico's Tony Hillerman Portal records [S15]. In Pueblo thought the mole holds the downward direction, with the color black, the earth and the crops [S15].

closing: The river runs on above you. You have had your bellyful.
